answer: Optimistic enrollment: each agent locks a refundable deposit and posts a cipher of a unique tag. The ledger also paints a pigment on the account from its first work-neighbors. Anyone who proves two tags collide, or that two accounts share that pigment and act in lockstep, slashes both deposits and keeps a bounty. An attacker spinning a spiral of clones must fund a fresh deposit per head and still loses the farm if one collision is found.
